description: Registered OpenDDE run stores for the held-out do-not-run audit (scripts/qualification/run_audit.py; plan revision 75 onward). Register every new store here before its first run; this file lives outside scripts/qualification, so registering a store is not a contract amendment. Paths are on gnode2 unless stated.

stores.note: Step 0 baselines, calibration, controls, smoke tests for contracts 1-5 (2026-10-10 to 2026-10-12). Many early runs predate run records; their seeds come from the output layout and their inputs only from job names.
Porting checkout; searched for ad hoc output directories (none found on 2026-10-14).
Job scripts and logs; searched for ad hoc output directories (none found on 2026-10-14).
Pre-tag contract-6 GPU provenance check (job 50623): D1, D4 and D5 at development seed 101, reduced recipe.

A100 stock step 0 and calibration (user go-ahead 2026-10-14): development rows D1-D15 and repository examples only, development seeds 101 and 102; outputs under runs/, job scripts under jobs/, logs under logs/. The VM is ephemeral; its outputs, logs and tier 1 captures are copied to /mnt/compbio-data/yang.su/opendde-a100/2026-10-14 on gnode2.
stores.retired: 2026-10-15 (SSH refused after all outputs were relayed)

stores.note: Copies of the A100 VM runs, logs and tier 1 captures; verification coverage and relocation map are in porting_docs/qualification_records/storage_relocation_2026-10-16.json. Most relays were checked against streamed VM-side sha256 lists, which were not kept. runs/step0/ab-43, runs/step0/cpu-42 and runs/smoke-41 were never checksum-checked against the VM; only their intermediate /data-to-NAS move was verified, and that manifest was not kept. The VM is retired and these historical provenance gaps remain unresolved. Setup recipe and job scripts are in ~/opendde-dev-checks/a100 (README.md); the initial /data-to-NAS move was user-approved on 2026-10-14. The replacement VM's copies (2026-10-17/) were each verified against a VM-side source manifest kept under 2026-10-17/manifests/. 2026-10-17/accept-sm80 is the whole store of acceptance line accept/sm80-fast80-87526cb, including the held-out draw sm80-fast-1 outputs (draw-1/, a logged draw): 3,328 files verified 2026-10-19 against manifests/accept-sm80-closure.sha256 (SHA-256 076d1dcba84c957c3e0a98ba9ad0b7f34d2e86209710155022b962947b29e6f9; job 54573), the files added after the rehearsal copy taken from the line's verified archive copy on the same NAS.

Bulk porting outputs that are not qualification evidence (user decision 2026-10-14; README.md there). sm120-captures/ holds copies of the sm_120 tier 1 capture directories from opendde-step0 and opendde-standin under the same relative paths, with source sha256 manifests in sm120-captures/MANIFESTS.

Dedicated sm_120 acceptance checkout (decision 2026-10-11), a clone of the approved fork created 2026-10-17 at the first fast candidate's code commit 25267ec; runs and measurements write outside it. Searched for ad hoc output directories before use.

First fast candidate (25267ec, --optimization_mode fast): the paired D1/D9 candidate smoke test (smoke/) and the D1-D15 development evidence and rehearsal record (rehearsal-1/). Development rows and development seeds 101 and 102 only.

Archive copies of closed acceptance lines, one directory per line with its source manifests (accept-sm120-fast-25267ec: rejected, 2026-10-17; accept-sm80-fast80-87526cb: rejected, 2026-10-19). Copies, not new runs; originals stay in their registered stores until the storage-admin procedure protects the archive.

Second A100 VM (replacement host; A100 80GB PCIe, driver 595.91.07): the E6 replacement-host acceptance test, A100 kernel porting, the D4 tier 1 drift diagnosis against the 2026-10-14 archive, the sm_80 calibration repeat on this host (runs/cal-2026-10-17) and the predeclared --deterministic false validation contrast (runs/val-2026-10-17, uninspected until the proposed limits and audit are written; user go-aheads 2026-10-17); the sm_80 fast kernel's development validation (runs/f80-2026-10-18) and the development rehearsal of its candidate 87526cb under contract-7 (accept-sm80/: smoke/, rehearsal-1/, operator/, jobs/; user go-ahead 2026-10-18), and acceptance line accept/sm80-fast80-87526cb, opened 2026-10-18 with the dedicated acceptance checkout opendde-accept (a clone of the approved fork) and the contract-7 gate checkout opendde-c7-gate; its held-out draw sm80-fast-1 (accept-sm80/draw-1: H1-H10 at the logged seeds 222-241, user go-ahead 2026-10-18) and the line's closure as rejected (accept-sm80/operator-closure, accept-sm80/logs; 2026-10-19). Outside accept-sm80/draw-1, development rows D1-D15 and repository examples only, development seeds 101 and 102; no held-out input. Same path as the retired 2026-10-14 VM's store, on a different host. The VM is ephemeral: outputs are copied to /mnt/compbio-data/yang.su/opendde-a100/2026-10-17 on gnode2.
